visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with dark hair, wearing a yellow and white varsity jacket over a purple shirt, stands on an indoor stage. He holds a microphone and speaks with a friendly expression. To his left is a large cat mascot with a blue cap and yellow overalls. The background features a large banner with 'PET EXPO CHAMPIONSHIP 2025' and forest-themed graphics. (2) The scene cuts to various shots of a Thai male celebrity (Billkin) performing on a stage under bright spotlights. He wears the same yellow varsity jacket. He sings and dances while interacting with the crowd. (3) The vlogger appears in a close-up selfie shot, smiling in a brightly lit indoor hallway. (4) A close-up shows a hand holding a 20 Thai Baht bill at a ticket counter. (5) Multiple shots of pets at the expo follow: a cat in a stroller wearing a sailor outfit, small black and white pigs in a hay-filled pen, and a white cat wearing sunglasses and a pearl collar in a luxury stroller. (6) Back on stage, Billkin interacts with the cat mascot, playfully touching its head. The crowd is visible in the background, mostly sitting in chairs and holding up smartphones to record. (7) Billkin walks off the stage into the aisle to sing directly to the fans in the front rows. Large LED screens display the 'Me-O x Billkin' collaboration logo.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Travel/Expo Journey -> Climax (Meeting/Performance) -> Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the vlogger's experience attending a celebrity endorsement event at a pet expo in Bangkok. It serves as a combination of a travel vlog and a fan's report of a meeting with Thai celebrity Billkin, highlighting the event's activities and the products being promoted (Me-O cat food).
